test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which type of forests Tendu, Amaltas, Bael (Bengal Quince) are found in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dry deciduous forests**__.

__
 
• **Dry deciduous forests**__ are more pronounced in areas that record annual rainfall between 70–100 cm.

 __
 
• The main species found in moist deciduous forests are teak, shisham, sal, hurra, amla, safflower and sandalwood.
 
• The main species found in dry deciduous forests are **tendu, amaltas, bael, Khair, excelword, palas**__ etc.
